reason: PURE. What I noticed first was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, then the one-hand tear sachets. I travel twice a month and a sachet beats a bottle in my carry-on, and a dollar a day is okay, but I would buy one box to try, not a subscription.
objection: 30 little foil packets is more trash, and $29.99 is a bit more than the bottle of magnesium I can get at the drugstore for less. I am paying extra for the packaging.
would_change_my_mind: A coupon or flash sale bringing it to about $22 to $24, or a smaller trial box so I can test it before committing to 30.
